Lina (CS): FYI — QuillWorks just told our AE they want to roll embeddings/search to 3 new teams (analytics, support, docs). They expect ~3–5x traffic uplift. Asking about predictable latency and an option for a Dedicated pilot. Renewal in ~8 weeks, feels sensitive.
Tom (Solutions): Do we have rough QPS / token estimates from them? Any new use cases (real-time vs batch)?
Lina (CS): Quick notes from call: analytics will run nightly batch embeddings (~10M tokens/day), support will do near-real-time reranking (burst QPS ~40), docs team will index/semantic-search (continuous ingest 2M tokens/day). So combined estimate ~15M tokens/day steady, with spikes to ~30M on release days. They care about EU residency.
Aisha (Eng): Thanks. Two asks: 1) if they want Dedicated pilot for SLAs (latency/p99), we need region and peak concurrency. 2) Is auditing/KMS required?
Lina (CS): Yes EU region (EU-WEST). They asked for KMS + audit logs for compliance. Renewal concerns — they said cost unpredictability would push them to consider vendor lock alternatives.
Tom (Solutions): For a pilot we could propose a 6-week Dedicated pilot: 2x GPU pool (A10g-ish) + autoscaling to handle peaks, with usage caps. Also offer a short enablement playbook and a migration checklist.
Lina (CS): Can we get capacity thumbprint and an estimate of cost delta vs hosted? They'll ask procurement.
eng-capacity-bot: Estimated profile for QuillWorks: steady tokens/day=15,000,000; peak tokens/day=30,000,000; recommended pilot config=2xdedicated-pool-eu-west (8 vGPU equiv). Estimated monthly incremental cost (pilot) ~ $18,500. Use batching + prefix caching to drop per-token cost ~20%.
Aisha (Eng): That config seems doable. Need platform sign-off for EU KMS integration and to provision isolated namespace. @Devon can you confirm support handoff for onboarding?
Devon (Customer Success): I can own the onboarding runbook. I'll schedule a joint enablement: Solutions + Eng + CS + customer success workshop. Proposed dates next week on Tue/Wed. Also will prepare a renewal play: usage forecast + cost comparison + ROI from query latency improvements.
Tom (Solutions): I'll draft a condensed playbook: 1) data residency & KMS checklist 2) ingestion patterns & recommended batching 3) monitoring thresholds & runbook 4) escalation path. Will ping eng for config snippets.
Lina (CS): Great — main blockers: A) EU KMS approval B) procurement ok with pilot cost C) quick pilot start so we can show ROI before renewal.
Aisha (Eng): I'll open an internal ticket for EU KMS and isolated tenancy. Tagging infra team. ETA for infra readiness ~ 4 business days if approved.
Lina (CS): Perfect. I'll prep customer-facing email and attach proposed pilot SOW + cost sheet.
Tom (Solutions): +1. Also add a small eval checklist we can use to quantify quality regressions vs hosted.
Lina (CS): Thanks all — will update thread after I send the SOW. :eyes:
